partner_result_applied.name: QFORM-Q0-DIFFUSE-OR-BIANCHOR-v1
partner_result_applied.application: Partner fixed-anchor packet mass >1/15552 is dominated by full anchored M00; new exterior/correlation theorem converts it into paired edge volume or star-star-transverse volume, and the paired-light N3 branch is paid by a continuous density bound <223.

new_results.statement: For B=[[b,r^T],[c,C]], the anchored third-minor array is T=b wedge^2 C-L_c C i_r; ||L_c C i_r||_HS^2=||r||^2||c||^2||P_cperp C P_rperp||_F^2.
For paired anchored 3x3/residual 2x2 volume Z_pair and one residual paired marginal side <=h<5/8, the full form has continuous density <=10 e^(2/5)2^(-1/10)(2h)^(-1/2)/(5-8h) Z_pair^(-1/5).
In N3(tau), tau<=1, the partner bi-anchor packet plus U-correlation and paired marginal max<=9/16 gives ||p_Q||_inf<223 continuously; otherwise a four-anchor paired packet >1/(248832 sqrt2) remains.
